comment: teleport.c teleds() 513-520: a debug Valkyrie kills a jackal, wears wished water walking boots, wishes a pool under herself and reads a scroll of punishment there (ball and chain in the pool), then walks east wishing two more pools, so the chain lies in the middle pool.
